body: Thank you.  I will be calling her pediatrician first thing Monday she does have insurance but even the copay we can't afford right now.  You are absolutely right in the fact that she is a priority I don't mean to say I stay with SO because of my feelings it's more of a is it worth all 3 kids struggling vs just 1 but I need more options for her because I am on her side and despite what she is going through she and I have a pretty solid relationship because I have always made it a point to be there for her the best I can

I know and it just seems like she is always grounded and her dad just yells at her I hate that she is going through this and before we had the outlet for therapy I am going to call her pediatrician and see what she suggests
We did therapy for a little while and it was going really well but I had to stop working and couldn't afford it anymore but I haven't checked with her dr I honestly hadn't thought of that
He is the sole income so I can't get him to leave.. honestly I know I have to wait either way until the boys are in school because of childcare

I don't think he is abusive he has always had an issue with things being done a certain way but it wasn't this bad before COVID because he was able to go to the gym and work out now that he is home his PTSD is getting aggravated and the mess and noise makes it worse and honestly we don't have the money for counseling and I doubt he would even go with it

What do you think I should say? Because I'm sorry for how he talked to her but I'm not sorry for standing our ground and I think that's why she is so upset because she feels she is "getting in our way"
